title: Cherrypicking
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Create CSV transfer file
steps.instruction:
Prepare a .csv file that includes the exact headers: Source Labware, Source Slot, Source Well, Source Aspiration Height Above Bottom (in mm), Dest Labware, Dest Slot, Dest Well, Volume (in ul). Fill each row with the appropriate values; for example:
Source Labware,Source Slot,Source Well,Source Aspiration Height Above Bottom (in mm),Dest Labware,Dest Slot,Dest Well,Volume (in ul)
agilent_1_reservoir_290ml,1,A1,1,nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt,4,A11,1
nest_12_reservoir_15ml,2,A1,1,nest_96_wellplate_2ml_deep,5,A5,3
nest_1_reservoir_195ml,3,A1,1,nest_96_wellplate_2ml_deep,5,H12,7

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map, placing each labware (e.g., reservoirs, plates) in the slots specified in the CSV file.

steps.title: Load tipracks into empty slots
steps.instruction: Place tipracks in all available empty slots; the robot will automatically recognize and use them, and will pause to prompt the user to refill tipracks if they become empty during the run.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate all labware, the tiprack(s), and the single‑channel pipette according to the app’s instructions (refer to the support articles for guidance).

steps.title: Run cherrypicking protocol
steps.instruction: Start the protocol; the robot will parse the prepared .csv file and perform the defined well‑to‑well liquid transfers with the calibrated single‑channel pipette.
